text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down without any trades, so short-term price changes alone are not a reason to act; past moves do not predict future returns.","I should judge each holding by its future risk and prospects, not by its average cost—avoiding a loss on paper or locking in a gain should not drive my decisions.","Even when I trade rarely, I should periodically check that my portfolio is diversified and its risk still suits my needs."]}
